server.title: Server Configuration
server.description: Configure your inference server URL and MCP server port.

data_description.api_key: Required for cloud providers. Optional for local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM): leave blank unless the server needs a key.

openclaw_pairing.title: OpenClaw Device Pairing

data_description.openclaw_session_key: Only used when Session Mode is 'Fixed'. Enter a short key such as 'main' or a full session ID such as agent:main:main.
data_description.hermes_session_key: Stable key scoping Hermes long-term memory for this profile.
data_description.openclaw_agent_id: The OpenClaw agent that answers this profile's requests. It must match an agent configured in OpenClaw. Default is 'main'.
data_description.openclaw_session_mode: 'Per conversation' gives each Home Assistant conversation its own OpenClaw session, so follow-up questions stay in it. 'Fixed' sends every request to the single session set in Session Key.
data_description.system_prompt: Sent to OpenClaw with every request as an extra system prompt, for example to set a persona. Leave blank to use the agent's own prompts. The satellite's room is added automatically.
data_description.thinking_mode: Controls reasoning on models that think before answering. Off is fastest for voice. Server default sends nothing. Not every server honours it (LM Studio is unreliable).

mcp_server.title: Shared MCP Server Settings
mcp_server.description: ⚠️ These settings affect ALL profiles. Changes here will impact every MCP Assist conversation agent.

data_description.searxng_url: Address of your SearXNG instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8888. JSON output must be enabled in its settings.yml (search: formats: json).

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the inference server. Make sure it's running and accessible.
error.no_models: No models loaded on the server. Please load a model first.
error.invalid_model: The specified model is not available on the server.
error.invalid_ip: Invalid IP address or CIDR range format. Use comma-separated values like: 172.30.0.0/16, 192.168.1.100
error.invalid_json: Invalid JSON format. Please check your MCP servers configuration.
error.invalid_api_key: Invalid API key. Please check and try again.
error.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Please verify your API key.
error.openclaw_not_paired: Device not yet approved on the OpenClaw server. Please approve it and try again.
error.openclaw_connection_failed: Could not connect to the OpenClaw gateway. Check the host, port, and token.

data_description.openclaw_session_key: Only used when Session Mode is 'Fixed'. Enter a short key such as 'main' or a full session ID such as agent:main:main.

data_description.openclaw_agent_id: The OpenClaw agent that answers this profile's requests. It must match an agent configured in OpenClaw. Default is 'main'.
data_description.openclaw_session_mode: 'Per conversation' gives each Home Assistant conversation its own OpenClaw session, so follow-up questions stay in it. 'Fixed' sends every request to the single session set in Session Key.
data_description.api_key: Required for cloud providers. Optional for local servers (LM Studio, llama.cpp, Ollama, vLLM): leave blank unless the server needs a key.
data_description.thinking_mode: Controls reasoning on models that think before answering. Off is fastest for voice. Server default sends nothing. Not every server honours it (LM Studio is unreliable).
data_description.mem0_enabled: Off by default. When on, this profile can search and save long-term memories on a self-hosted Mem0 server. Nothing is sent while this is off.
data_description.mem0_url: Base URL of the Mem0 REST server. Default is http://127.0.0.1:8888.
data_description.mem0_api_key: Sent as the X-API-Key header. Leave blank if the server does not require a key.
data_description.mem0_user_id: Mem0 user id that scopes this profile's memories. Default is homeassistant.
data_description.mem0_auto_save: Off by default. When on, each finished turn is sent to Mem0 in the background. Skipped if save_memory already ran in that turn. If Mem0 cannot be reached, the conversation still completes.
